newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks slip amid political unrest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks slip amid political unrest.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Sunday amid bearish sentiment prompted by political unrest, dealers said.
They said the market was likely to open mixed on Monday, the last clearing day, as major investors would remain cautious.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 3.07 points, or 0.22 percent, to end at 1,421.44. Losers led gainers 128 to 94. Turnover fell to 19.16 million shares from 19.42 million in the previous session on Thursday.
Faysal Bank fell 0.75 to 22 rupees, Muslim Commercial Bank 3.0 to 39 and Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.35 to 27.60.
Hub Power Co fell 0.15 to 32.90 but Sui Northern Gas rose 1.25 to 41.75. Pak Suzuki Motor rose 0.75 to 44. PTCL fell 0.15 to 31.95.
